name: HTML BASICS
description: Master the structure of the web

rules.text: Type any text to get started!
rules.hint: HTML can display text directly. Try typing 'Hello World' or any message you like. This text will appear in the preview!

rules.text: Now wrap your text in a <p> tag
rules.hint: The <p> tag creates a paragraph. Use it like this: <p>Your text here</p>. The opening tag <p> starts the paragraph, and the closing tag </p> ends it.

rules.text: Add a heading using the <h1> tag
rules.hint: Headings make text bigger and bolder. HTML has 6 heading sizes (h1-h6). Try: <h1>My Title</h1> above your paragraph. H1 is the largest!

rules.text: Create a list with at least 2 items using <ul> and <li>
rules.hint: Lists organize items with bullet points. Structure: <ul> (starts the list) then <li>Item 1</li> and <li>Item 2</li> then </ul> (ends the list)

rules.text: Add a link using the <a> tag with an href attribute
rules.hint: Links connect web pages! Use: <a href="https://google.com">Click me</a>. The href attribute tells the browser where to go when clicked.

rules.text: Make something bold with <strong> and italic with <em>
rules.hint: <strong>makes text bold</strong> and <em>makes text italic</em>. These tags emphasize important text. Try using both in your content!

checkParams.function: (code) => { const hasStrong = code.includes('') && code.includes(''); const hasEm = code.includes('') && code.includes(''); return hasStrong && hasEm; }

rules.text: Create a complete HTML document with <html>, <head>, and <body> tags
rules.hint: A proper HTML document has structure: <html> (root), <head> (metadata), <body> (visible content). Wrap everything: <html><head></head><body>[your content]</body></html>

checkParams.function: (code) => { const hasHtml = code.includes('<html>') && code.includes('</html>'); const hasHead = code.includes('<head>') && code.includes('</head>'); const hasBody = code.includes('<body>') && code.includes('</body>'); return hasHtml && hasHead && hasBody; }
